interpretation: Validation development simulation with synthetic inventory assumptions; not real business savings or new held-out evidence
cost_unit: synthetic cost units; not a currency or estimated actual cost

policies.name: weekday_mean
policies.target: ceil(sum of origin-available point forecasts over protection days)

policies.name: buffered_weekday_mean
policies.target: ceil(1.5 times sum of origin-available point forecasts over protection days)

starting_stock: common across policies: ceil(pre-validation 56-day mean times (lead time + 7))
inventory_position: on-hand after receipts plus all outstanding pipeline units; no backlog
order_quantity: max(0, target stock minus inventory position), integer units
receipt_timing: start of origin/order date plus synthetic calendar-day lead time; never same-day arrival
daily_event_order: weekly review and order before current-day scenario sales
fulfill observed positive sales up to available stock
sales_replay: one processed observed-positive-sales value per SKU/calendar date; not verified uncensored demand
forecast_vintage: latest saved issue date on or before review; allow aged final forecast, never future issues or extrapolation
protection_days: min(lead time + 7, number of dates remaining through 2011-09-04)
terminal_orders: do not place orders whose arrival is on or after 2011-09-05
terminal_accounting: report remaining stock/pipeline; no salvage credit, future costs or terminal shortage penalty beyond scenario end
cost_overlay: one physical ledger per SKU/policy/lead-time; apply both shortage prices to the same ledger without replaying sales twice
metrics: mean daily closing inventory (total across SKUs and per SKU)
zero_sales_denominator: fulfilled-unit rate undefined when scenario-input unit total is zero; no epsilon
interval_usage: none: buffer is a fixed heuristic multiplier on point forecasts; daily bounds are not summed or treated as calibrated lead-time uncertainty
plot_rule: one fixed aggregate sensitivity figure across all predefined lead times, shortage prices and policies; no selected best/worst examples
